Notes: Shadow School, Stage D1: Dalia Falmea inside the hearth binding (ConquestEncounters.cs, encounter Falmea). The base is the game's own Wizard City Falmea combat template (DaliaFalmea-WCBoss-R7: Falmea's model, boss, level 7, 4000 health, no base effects), whose deck is Cyrus Drake's Myth set; here she is a Fire instructor held back by the binding: Fire, level 10, 950 health, no pierce, critical, block or power pips, starting with no pips. Her deck is Fire damage over time and tempo (verified spell templates): Fire Cat 103007158, Fire Elf 1243857701 (damage over time), Sunbird 1599065470 (twice a battle), Fire Trap 400321766 and Fireblade 603748810 (twice each). A win gives no extra experience or gold (the quest is the reward and it is given once).
